text:
HUUB needs a WordPress developer who can build new features, work closely across design and operations, and help small businesses get easier access to the resources they need.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience, and I’d be excited to support HUUB on a part-time basis. My background includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, which gives me a strong foundation for building polished, reliable user experiences and shipping features end to end.

One project that’s especially relevant is a booking platform for fitness studios I built for Pulsebox Studios. I created a white-label class booking app where each studio had its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. That project involved multi-tenancy and subscription billing, and it helped onboard 64 studios in 6 months while achieving a 71% checkout conversion rate. It was a good example of working on a product that needed to be both functional and easy to use, while keeping the experience consistent across multiple users and organizations.

What draws me to HUUB is the mission as much as the product work. Helping governments better support small businesses is meaningful, and I’d like to contribute to a platform that creates real value for entrepreneurs and the advisors who support them. I’m comfortable working in a small, cross-functional team, collaborating from design through release, and maintaining a detail-oriented approach to testing and quality.

While my core background is in modern web development, I’m confident bringing that experience into a WordPress environment where thoughtful front-end work, feature development, and careful implementation matter. I’d love the chance to help HUUB improve the platform, ship new features, and contribute to a better experience for business owners and advisors.
